In 1910 almost all of Europe was ruled by a handful of royal families, many of them related. Here is who held which crown.

a thread 🧵🗺️
1/ The map shows Hohenzollern in Germany, Habsburg in Austria-Hungary, Holstein-Gottorp-Romanov in Russia, Savoy in Italy, Bourbon in Spain, Bernadotte in Sweden and Orange-Nassau in the Netherlands.
2/ Britain is shown as Saxe-Coburg and Gotha. That German name lasted until 1917, when George V switched the royal house's name to Windsor because of anti-German feeling in WWI.
3/ The Hohenzollerns also ruled Romania, shown in the same colour as Germany, through a separate branch that took the Romanian throne in 1866.
4/ Within about eight years the Romanovs (1917), Hohenzollerns and Habsburgs (1918) had all lost their thrones. The Savoy crown lasted longer: Italy's monarchy ended on 18 June 1946.
5/ France and Switzerland, in black, were the republics on the map. Which dynasty on this map do you think was the most secure in 1910? Follow @forummapping for more maps like this.
